linear.name: Linear
linear.coverage: Current primary-source defaults are playable. Four historical bindings are retained as reference-only. Reserved modifiers are also reference-only. This is a reviewed snapshot, not a live keymap feed. Letter shortcuts are identical on Windows per Linear's docs; Cmd shortcuts map to Ctrl as reference only.

notes: The June 11, 2026 release note supersedes Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + S still shown on the editor help page.

notion.name: Notion
notion.coverage: Expanded snapshot of the official keyboard reference. Block navigation and Shift editing actions are playable; reserved modifiers and Esc are reference-only. Typed slash/Markdown commands and mouse gestures are documented separately. Mac Delete is the Backspace physical key. English US QWERTY.

shortcuts.context: Page, to-do, toggle, image or embed

jira.name: Jira
jira.coverage: Partial current Jira Cloud starter pack. Shortcuts must be enabled in Jira. This pack currently contains singles only; no inferred legacy sequences or modifier access keys.

superhuman.name: Superhuman
superhuman.coverage: Partial v8 starter pack. Windows bindings checked against https://download.superhuman.com/Superhuman_Keyboard_Shortcuts.pdf. Not Superhuman Docs or Go. Context excludes composing. US QWERTY.

excel.name: Excel
excel.coverage: Partial desktop starter pack. Default Return direction and Scroll Lock off. Function keys and Ctrl/Cmd/Option bindings are reference-only. Mac Delete uses physical Backspace; Windows Backspace clears the active cell.
